entries.zh: 从今以后；自此以往（照此下去）
entries.en: from now on; henceforth; and so forth

entries.zh: （自创世之初）向来如此；照此方式
entries.en: in that manner (as it has been) since the beginning of the world
entries.notes: 西语系 desa manera 之续例；M 栏含栏内冒号、R 栏 jīg 与汉字「適」不协，中文对应无从定夺，释义仅据 L 栏。

entries.en: to disdain; to scorn; to pay no heed
entries.notes: H 栏作「险(險)」与 desdeñar／no hacer caſo 不合；据 M hram、R hiěñ（hiâm／xián）当为「嫌」，故定此义。

entries.en: 〔original damaged; gloss uncertain〕
entries.notes: L 栏「Deſdequi」即 desde aquí（从这里），义本明；然 H、M 两栏空缺，R 仅存「pyne )」残片，无中文对应可据。

entries.en: misfortune; bad luck; unlucky (omen)
unfortunate; wretched
entries.notes: H 栏「虜」带 [疑]，且 M／R 音写 cúj ý 与「不幸」义无对应，释义据 L 栏 desdichado 定，汉字待核。

entries.en: to desire; to covet
entries.notes: L 短语「codicia lo puido go」残损；H 栏「彭」于常用义与「欲求」无涉，M 栏并存 pē／pyng 两读，释义据 deſear／codicia 定。

entries.en: to want; to wish; to desire
to love; to be fond of; to want
to hope for (and nothing else); to look forward to

entries.zh: 渴望见到（某人）；极想一见
entries.en: to long to see (someone)
to be eager to return home
to desire the principal (capital sum); to covet capital
entries.notes: L「co Braval principal」残损难读；H「彭本」之「本」与西语 principal（本金）相合，故定「图本」一义。

entries.en: to want to gamble
to wish to see (someone) for his fame; to admire
entries.notes: H 栏「歆」带 [疑:歆／欽]，两读皆取「慕」义，不碍释义；L 明言 por ſu fama。

entries.en: to be ambitious; to crave great things
to be devoted to learning; to be eager to study

entries.zh: 郁抑；郁结不伸（所欲不得）
entries.en: pent-up; depressed (desire stifled)
entries.notes: L 短语「darva con deſiel」严重残损，M 栏 vor eg 与 R 栏 vrē g 皆带 T99 污损，仅 H 栏「鬱抑」可据。

entries.en: to be fond of sleep; sleepy
good desires; good wishes
entries.notes: H 栏「發現」（显现）与 L deseos buenos（善愿）语义不协，而 M／R 音写一致，疑原稿别有其字；释义据 L 栏定。
